inlineFindings.reason: Existing cancellation-await race test retains the second generation check.

Negotiated v1 child steering uses the acknowledgement RPC; injected and startedNewTurn return promptly, promptRequired falls back once. Attachment, identity, close and Stop races cannot submit stale work.
Disabled agent-hook settings remain checked before any account hook preparation.
Account picker refresh uses the shared forced quota refresh, refetches account metadata and keeps its busy state until both settle.
Unsafe attribution storage selects an in-memory authority scoped to the host directory; it never rotates an unsafe stored key or trusts another host authority.
Inherited hook preparation honors disabled integrations.
Unsupported ordinary custom-argument/API-key/unpinned launches return no background discovery candidate; actual pending attachment proof failures still refuse.
The saved-conversation reader resolves the supplied database path.
Recovery event/state writes are transactional; a failed event write rolls back the switch.
Unavailable quota uses a strict public-field projection; no runtime credential fields are spread into the result.
The Node-only Codex quota suite is registered in the existing terminal integration task executed by CI.
The migration test is Node-only and registered through the local-db test script and Turbo.
Fixture setup applies only migrations before 0060, then the migration under test; later migrations cannot run first.
Dashboard quota and wallet readers receive the same transport-offline state as the widget. Original dates remain visible and historical.

The original deadline bounds response plus JSON decoding. Optional profile, wallet and history work cannot erase admitted quota or extend the deadline. Late explicit auth denial revokes proof immediately. Pending history is isolated per hashed credential and bounded.
Main persistence, settings, dashboard and widget share the verified provider identity gate. Unsupported identities remain visible/hideable without offering a rejected color save.
Same ordinary-resume scope issue as r4372890489; #8888 inherits its tested fix.

A failed background attachment reservation is released only after exact owned-terminal exit and daemon non-liveness are proven, with unchanged source and no successor binding. Its dedicated shell exits when the real attach client ends; live or ambiguous shells stay protected.

reviewBodyNotes.heading: Raise the strict Keychain timeout above 750 ms, or treat a timeout as a retryable read.
reviewBodyNotes.reason: A long or interactive Keychain read can fail the strict capture, but no actual 750 ms timeout was established. Apple documents interaction requirements, not a recommended latency bound. Raising a per-command timeout or retrying inside the shared 2 s capture can consume its deadline and cannot guarantee prompt completion. Preserve strict refusal to use unverified credentials; no permission/identity fallback was weakened.

reviewBodyNotes.heading: Allow Vite development support in the usage widget CSP.
reviewBodyNotes.reason: Development-only post-transform CSP hashes the actual React preamble and permits only the exact loopback HMR origin. Packaged HTML policy is byte-identical. Actual Vite/React transform and WebSocket reload smoke passed.
